title: Comparative Analysis of Four Assessments for Fall Risk Detection
summary: The aim of the exploratory study is to conduct a comparative evaluation of the predictive performance of four different fall risk assessment tools, including some AI-supported assessments, within a clinical setting.
conditions: Predictive properties of various assessments for fall risk detection, including AI-supported approaches

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Capacity to provide Informed Consent
- Minimum duration of hospitalization of 48 hours
- Mobility score up to Jones-4a
Exclusion criteria:
- Age < 18 years
- Immobility (Jones-4b)
- Legal guardianship
